metadata.content: Kosta Nedeljkovic: Rangers sign Aston Villa right-back on loan with £4m obligation to buy Serbia international | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Kosta Nedeljkovic: Rangers sign Aston Villa right-back on loan with £4m obligation to buy Serbia international Rangers have signed 11 players this summer; Kosta Nedeljkovic joins amid interest from other clubs following talks with boss Derek McInnes and Serbian team-mate Vanja Dragojevic, who just moved to Ibrox; Rangers are working on adding a winger and striker before the transfer window shuts Wednesday 19 August 2026 10:06, UK Image: Kosta Nedeljkovic has joined Rangers Rangers have signed right-back Kosta Nedeljkovic from Aston Villa. The 20-year-old has moved to Ibrox on a season-long loan, with a £4m obligation to buy included in the deal, which will be triggered based on the number of games he plays. Sky Sports News understands Rangers saw off competition from other clubs to sign Nedeljkovic after he held talks with manager Derek McInnes and his Serbia team-mate Vanja Dragojevic, who moved to the club earlier this summer. messages.text: Watkins keen on move to Al Hilal as talks ongoing with Villa

metadata.summary: Al Hilal are in talks with Aston Villa over a deal to sign striker Ollie Watkins, who is keen on the move.
metadata.content: Ollie Watkins transfer: Aston Villa in talks with Saudi club Al Hilal over England striker | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Ollie Watkins transfer: Aston Villa in talks with Saudi club Al Hilal over England striker England striker Ollie Watkins being targeted as potential replacement for Karim Benzema but Al Hilal have had one offer already knocked back; Watkins scored 16 goals in Premier League last season for Aston Villa and earned a spot in Thomas Tuchel's England squad for World Cup Wednesday 19 August 2026 11:42, UK Image: Talks remain ongoing between Al Hilal and Aston Villa over the signing of Ollie Watkins Al Hilal are in talks with Aston Villa over a deal to sign striker Ollie Watkins, who is keen on the move. Sky Sports News understands the Saudi club have already seen a €45m (£38.5m) offer rejected by Villa, but negotiations remain ongoing as they look to find a solution. Villa also need to sign a replacement and that is expected to be a factor in the decision to allow Watkins to proceed with the move. Watkins, 30, is being targeted as a potential replacement for Karim Benzema, with Al Hilal also working on a way to resolve the Frenchman's contract situation and allow him to leave the club. metadata.summary: Paul Elliott is eyeing a 'life-changing' world title shot should he come through his ONE Championship heavyweight bout with Shamil Erdogan, but stopped short of promising another record-equalling knockout.
metadata.content: ONE Fight Night 48: Paul Elliott eyes 'life-changing' world title shot with win over Shamil Erdogan | MMA News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive ONE Fight Night 48: Paul Elliott eyes 'life-changing' world title shot with win over Shamil Erdogan ONE Fight Night 48 on Friday, October 2 - live on Sky Sports - also features Luke Lessei versus Charlie Guest in a hugely important Muay Thai match in terms of featherweight title picture - as the winner could push for a crack at Nico Carrillo's belt Wednesday 19 August 2026 08:24, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Paul Elliott knocked out Regan Upshaw with a head kick to record the fastest stoppage in One Championship history Paul Elliott is eyeing a 'life-changing' world title shot should he come through his ONE Championship heavyweight bout with Shamil Erdogan, but stopped short of promising another record-equalling knockout. The Middlesbrough-born fighter takes on Erdogan at ONE Fight Night 48 on Friday, October 2 - live on Sky Sports - with the winner possibly earning a shot at the vacant ONE heavyweight MMA world title, which was last held by Anatoly Malykhin before he retired. Elliott holds an 8-2 record, earning all of his wins by knockout, entering the history books in June when he tied the fastest knockout in ONE history by stopping Regan Upshaw in six seconds. messages.text: Will Man Utd's opening weekend defence be the same as 2022?

metadata.summary: Since the summer of 2022, Manchester United have signed eight defenders for a combined £219.7m - and yet, the starting back four could be the same that lined up on the opening day of the season four years ago.
metadata.content: Man Utd could start 2026/27 Premier League season with same back four as 2022/23 opening game | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Man Utd could start 2026/27 Premier League season with same back four as 2022/23 opening game Lisandro Martinez, Harry Maguire, Luke Shaw and Diogo Dalot were the starting back four on the opening weekend of the 2022/23 season; Michael Carrick used the same combination six times last year; however, the quartet have only played together 10 times in four years Charlotte Marsh Senior Football Journalist Wednesday 19 August 2026 08:45, UK Image: Credit - AP Photo/PA Since the summer of 2022, Manchester United have signed eight defenders for a combined £219.7m - and yet, the starting back four could be the same that lined up on the opening day of the season four years ago. On 7 August 2022, Erik ten Hag started Lisandro Martinez - an arrival that summer for £56.7m - Harry Maguire, Luke Shaw and Diogo Dalot, but suffered a 2-1 loss to Brighton. And in six of his 17 Premier League matches in 2026, Michael Carrick opted for the same back line and it could be again for this weekend's opening game against Hull City on Saturday.
